value_stream.name: Trade Reseller Floor-Plan & Dealer Inventory Financing

fields.Trigger: Daily aging run; curtailment-period expiry; sold-but-not-curtailed flag (W5382)

workflows.name: Dealer Aging, Curtailment Default & Out-of-Trust (OOT) Detection

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-aging and OOT-flagging with rule-based collections worklists and escalation.
Controls: - CTL-796: OOT/fraud detection; CTL-796 (aging accuracy); CTL-796 (cure-authority separation).
Cross-references: - links to VS-68 (credit risk/aging), VS-23 (LP/fraud), VS-16 (AR aging)
Pain Points / Risks: - **OOT-accumulation risk**: unflagged OOT grows into large unsecured exposure before detection; mitigated by daily sold-vs-curtailed matching and aging.
- **Slow-cure risk**: weak cure follow-up lets a curable default become a loss; mitigated by defined cure timelines and escalation to workout.
System Touchpoints: - Floor-plan aging/OOT engine; collections/case module; risk-grade update (VS-68).

steps.activity: Run daily aging on curtailment and interest balances by dealer and bucket (current/30/60/90+).
Flag curtailment defaults (units sold but unpaid past period) and OOT exposure per dealer.
Triage: contact dealer, confirm cause, and set a cure timeline (pay-down or collateral substitution).
Escalate repeat/serious OOT to workout (W5386) and risk-grade downgrade (W5388).
Report portfolio aging and OOT exposure to the credit committee (W5391).

fields.Participants: Credit Manager, Legal (VS-100), Collections, Field Examiner
fields.Trigger: Default escalated from W5385; missed cure

workflows.name: Dealer Collection, Workout, Restructuring & Skip-Tracing for Missing Collateral

Automation Opportunity: - Default-driven case auto-creation with restructuring-calc and skip-trace worklist.
Controls: - CTL-109: collections fraud detection & case governance; CTL-796 (ensure controlled execution — Curtailment, Collections, Risk & Portfolio Analytics (PA-188.3).) — restructuring approval authority.
Cross-references: - links to VS-68 (credit), VS-100 (legal/enforcement), VS-23 (LP), VS-159 (security/skip-trace)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss-escalation risk**: weak workout lets a recoverable default become a write-off; mitigated by defined workout timelines and restructuring options.
- **Skip-trace failure risk**: unlocatable collateral (dealer concealed/sold) becomes unsecured loss; mitigated by serial-level tracking (W5379) and field-exam triggers.
System Touchpoints: - Workout/case module; collateral location/skip-trace; legal/enforcement records (VS-100); risk-grade update.

steps.activity: Assess the default: cause, dealer financial condition, and collateral status (field exam W5381 if stale).
Pursue collections: demand curtailment, negotiate a restructuring/extended cure where viable, or move to recovery.
For missing collateral, skip-trace the units (serial-level) to locate them for repossession (W5387).
Engage Legal for demand/default notice and enforcement of the security agreement (W5371).
Document the workout outcome (cured/restructured/recovery) and update the dealer risk grade/limit.

fields.Frequency: Rare (~1–3% of default cases reach repo); high impact
fields.Participants: Legal (VS-100), Corporate Security (VS-159), Repo Agent, Sales (disposition)

workflows.name: Collateral Repossession, Redemption & Disposition of Defaulted Floor-Plan Units

Automation Opportunity: - Repo-case workflow with redemption-clock and disposition options.
Controls: - CTL-796: ensure controlled execution — Curtailment, Collections, Risk & Portfolio Analytics (PA-188.3).) — legal authorization; CTL-26 (asset recovery; CTL-21 (recovery/deficiency accounting).
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal), VS-159 (security), VS-32/VS-155 (disposition/resale), VS-17 (GL), VS-23 (LP)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Wrongful-repo risk**: repossessing without proper legal basis exposes BuildRight to damages; mitigated by legal sign-off and documented default/security-agreement basis.
- **Recovery-shortfall risk**: disposing collateral below the outstanding balance leaves a deficiency to chase; mitigated by re-sale into BuildRight's channels at market and deficiency accounting.
System Touchpoints: - Collateral/case module; disposition order (VS-11/VS-32); GL recovery/deficiency posting (VS-17); records (VS-88).

steps.activity: Confirm the right to repossess under the security agreement (W5371) and applicable law; obtain legal sign-off.
Engage a licensed repo agent / Corporate Security to recover the units (serial-level) from the dealer.
Provide the dealer a redemption window to cure and reclaim before disposition.
Dispose of unredeemed collateral: re-sell into BuildRight's channels (VS-11/VS-32/VS-155) or wholesale to recover principal.
Account for recovery vs. outstanding balance; post any deficiency to the dealer and any surplus per law.

fields.Volume: 1 portfolio review/quarter; ~1,000 dealer grades (one per active dealer in the floor-plan portfolio per W5374/W5385)

workflows.name: Floor-Plan Portfolio Risk Rating, Concentration & Dealer Credit Limit Review

Automation Opportunity: - Risk-grade auto-scored from payment/aging/OOT/exam signals; concentration dashboard.
Controls: - CTL-796 (ensure controlled execution — Curtailment, Collections, Risk & Portfolio Analytics (PA-188.3).)
- operational: grading accuracy; limit-approval authority; concentration-limit adherence; .
Cross-references: - links to VS-68 (credit risk), VS-21 (risk/ERM), VS-18 (treasury exposure)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Concentration risk**: excessive exposure to a single dealer/segment/region magnifies default impact; mitigated by concentration limits and quarterly review.
- **Stale-grade risk**: a dealer's grade not updated as it deteriorates delays intervention; mitigated by trigger-based grade updates from aging/OOT.
System Touchpoints: - Credit-risk module (VS-68); portfolio concentration analytics; risk-grade/limit update.

steps.activity: Rate each dealer's risk grade from payment/aging/OOT/exam findings (W5381/W5385).
Analyze portfolio concentration by dealer, segment, region, and category vs. limits (W5369).
Review and adjust dealer floor-plan limits based on grade and performance (W5370).
Identify watch-list dealers for enhanced monitoring/workout (W5386).
Report portfolio risk profile and concentration to the credit/risk committee.

fields.Participants: Credit Manager, CFO, Internal Audit (VS-21), Tax (VS-79)

workflows.name: Loss Provisioning, Charge-off & Recovery Accounting for Floor-Plan Losses

Automation Opportunity: - ECL auto-computed from aging/grade data with documented methodology; charge-off workflow.
Controls: - CTL-31: adequate provisions; CTL-30 (month-end close); CTL-34 (tax-compliant charge-off); CTL-21 (accuracy).
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (GL), VS-157 (revenue/loss), VS-79 (tax), VS-21 (audit), VS-68 (credit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-provisioning risk**: an inadequate ECL distorts the audited PFRS financials and over-states income; mitigated by a documented PFRS 9 methodology and periodic audit.
- **Deductibility risk**: charge-offs not properly documented/deductible for BIR lose tax benefit; mitigated by documentation and tax review (VS-79).
System Touchpoints: - ECL/provisioning engine (PFRS 9 — VS-157/VS-17); GL; recovery-income posting; tax reconciliation (VS-79).
Time Estimate: - ~1 week per monthly provisioning cycle; ~2 days per charge-off batch.

steps.activity: Compute the expected credit loss (ECL) provision under PFRS 9 from aging/grade/default data (W5385/W5388).
Post the provision to the GL and provision contra-asset (VS-17); document methodology.
On a confirmed loss (unrecoverable): charge-off the principal net of provision and recovery (W5387).
Track recoveries post charge-off and recognize recovery income.
Reconcile provisions/charge-offs to the credit-risk and tax records (VS-79 BIR deductibility).

workflows.name: Dealer Performance, Sales Velocity, Stocking Health & Relationship Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-refreshing dealer-performance dashboard with segmentation and growth flags.
Controls: - CTL-796 (ensure controlled execution — Curtailment, Collections, Risk & Portfolio Analytics (PA-188.3).)
Cross-references: - links to VS-107 (key accounts), VS-103 (relationship/EX), VS-28 (BI), VS-11 (trade)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Growth-blindness risk**: missing high-velocity dealers limits growth opportunity; mitigated by performance segmentation and growth-flagging.
- **Stocking-health risk**: slow-moving funded stock indicates default risk and category issues; mitigated by stocking-health metrics feeding limit/review.
System Touchpoints: - BI/analytics on floor-plan + sales + curtailment data (VS-28); key-account analytics (VS-107).

steps.activity: Compute dealer performance: sales velocity, turn, curtailment timeliness, and stocking health.
Segment dealers by performance/risk (W5388) and identify growth/opportunity vs. watch-list.
Share insights with Trade Account Management for relationship/limit discussions (VS-107).
Identify under-performing stock/categories to feed assortment/limit decisions.
Track relationship metrics (NPS, retention, share-of-wallet) for the program (VS-107/VS-103).

workflows.name: Floor-Plan Portfolio Yield, Cost-of-Funds, NPL & Profitability Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-refreshing NIM/yield/NPL dashboard from treasury + GL + credit data.
Controls: - CTL-796 (ensure controlled execution — Curtailment, Collections, Risk & Portfolio Analytics (PA-188.3).)
- operational: profitability-data accuracy; vs. business case; treasury reconciliation; .
Cross-references: - links to VS-18 (treasury/funding), VS-17 (P&L), VS-28 (BI), VS-36/VS-173 (board)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Margin-erosion risk**: rising funding cost or rising NPL compresses NIM below target; mitigated by NIM monitoring and pricing/recovery action.
- **Business-case-drift risk**: actual profitability diverging from the business case undetected; mitigated by monthly actual-vs-case reporting.
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/funding analytics (VS-18); profitability dashboard (VS-28/VS-17); board reporting (VS-36/VS-173).

steps.activity: Compute portfolio yield, NIM (yield minus cost-of-funds W5373), and NPL/loss rate.
Reconcile financing-margin income, subvention, and recoveries to the P&L (W5383/W5389).
Compare to the business case (W5369) and risk-appetite targets; flag erosion.
Analyze funding mix and cost optimization (own balance sheet vs. facility — W5373).
Report program profitability to the credit/finance committee and board reporting (VS-36/VS-173).

fields.Trigger: Regulatory reporting cycle; BSP/SEC examination; internal audit plan

workflows.name: Regulatory Reporting, BSP Compliance Examination & Internal Audit Support

Automation Opportunity: - Regulatory reports auto-generated from the reconciled ledger; audit-evidence package.
Controls: - CTL-796 (ensure controlled execution — Curtailment, Collections, Risk & Portfolio Analytics (PA-188.3).)
- operational: statutory reporting; regulatory compliance; internal-audit independence (VS-21); accuracy; .
Cross-references: - links to VS-22 (compliance), VS-21 (audit), VS-86 (AML), VS-88 (records), VS-36/VS-173 (board), VS-100 (legal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Examination-finding risk**: an examination that finds weak origination/collateral/provisioning controls triggers regulatory action; mitigated by annual internal audit and control testing.
- **Reporting-error risk**: inaccurate regulatory reports are themselves violations; mitigated by ledger-reconciled reporting and review.
System Touchpoints: - Floor-plan ledger; regulatory reporting; audit-findings register (VS-21); records retention (VS-88).
Time Estimate: - ~2–3 weeks per regulatory cycle; ~3–4 weeks per internal audit.

steps.activity: Prepare regulatory reports (SEC/BSP lending-company, AML on floor-plan funds — VS-86) from the floor-plan ledger.
On BSP/SEC examination: provide loan files, collateral, provisioning, and disclosure evidence.
Support internal audit of origination, collateral, curtailment, and provisioning controls (VS-21).
Document and remediate findings; track to closure.
Escalate material findings/regulatory action to the board reporting (VS-36/VS-173).
